title_zh: 挑选适合初学者的纸牌魔术

scenario.goal_zh: 根据练习难度选择无需快速手法的纸牌魔术并约定先看示范

context_zh: 哈珀想在家庭聚会上表演一个简单魔术，但不擅长快速手部动作，向兴趣课教师询问练习选择。
author: author-phase06-b

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: I'd like to learn a card trick, but my hands aren't quick enough for the one you just showed us.

sentences.speaker: Magic Tutor
sentences.text: Then try this one. In my beginner classes, people typically learn it in one session because it doesn't require fast movements.

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: Can I simply follow the steps on this sheet?

sentences.speaker: Magic Tutor
sentences.text: Use the sheet to practise, but watch a demonstration first. The order matters, and the pictures don't show every movement.

sentences.speaker: Harper
sentences.text: All right. Could you show me slowly, and then watch while I try?

sentences.speaker: Magic Tutor
sentences.text: Of course. Sit beside me so you can see the cards, and we'll go through it together.
